model_name: trial-07 sc-generator + conditioned linear model x2
description: Cells are generated by the same model as trial-03, fitted on each context's own control cells; no control cell is copied into the prediction. The predicted effect of a target is the output of a regularised linear model trained on Replogle 2022 pseudobulk effects (K562 genome-wide and RPE1 essential screens; empirical-Bayes-shrunk log fold changes on the 6,835 genes measured in K562, RPE1 and HepG2). Its inputs are the target's own K562 effect (32 principal components; 272 of the 300 targets have one), the mean K562 effect of the target's STRING physical partners, the target's expression in the context's controls and in K562, and a per-gene gate on the K562 effect that is linear in each gene's expression in the context's controls against K562. It was selected and scored on held-out HepG2 targets (Nadig 2024), a context never used in training, where it did not beat the trial-03 recipe (difference in predicted score -0.009, 95% interval -0.036 to +0.017). The effect is applied at amplitude 2.0 with no cis term; the other 11,698 genes of the official axis keep the control level and the target gene is set to a fixed knockdown. No perturbed data from contexts A, B or C was used.
